results.notes: UA = Electric bikes 42c3ab89 (GB (EN) only, 1 category Commuter Electric Bikes + automatic Other, 31 rows, 5 kept). Pool block before: "996 / 1000 prompts · 5 selected". Category used: "Folding Electric Bikes" instead of "Courier services" (fits the topic, same as first run). Add Category dialog step 1 "Translations per Country: GB - English Folding Electric Bikes" > Next. Step 2 Prompts: 30 rows, 30/30 ticked, all category "Folding Electric Bikes", market GB (EN); pool block in view "1026 / 1000 prompts · 30 selected" with "26 prompts over. Untick prompts or contact your account manager." (pool already at 996/1000, not blocking the check). Type filter of the dialog: "Visibility 10 · Category Topics 10 · Competitive 10" - no Reputation or Brand Image row or filter value. Visibility wordings 'Best Folding Electric Bikes?', 'Top Folding Electric Bikes?'...; Competitive wordings with [Competitor 1] to [Competitor 4] and no brand (expected unbranded templates, see GEO-1241-012 / GEO-1242-005). POST /questions/adapt-batch allowed this time and returned 200 (first run: blocked, English templates + adaptation error banner); payload analysisMode UNBRANDED, entityName "Electric bikes", 10 PERCEPTION + 10 VISIBILITY + 10 COMPETITIVE; no adaptation error banner. Final "Add Category" never clicked; Cancel opened "Discard Category - Your category creation is incomplete..." > "Exit and Discard" (local only). After: 1 category, "996 / 1000 prompts · 5 selected". Guard: no non-GET request other than adapt-batch (hubspot login-event aborted).

(missing space).
